descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Sharpeye Shootout combines drone shooting and ring-flight challenges in VR. Its challenges emphasize visual tracking, color matching, aim and timing.

DRONE SHOOTING
Defend a Martian frontier town with a blue pistol in your left hand and a red pistol in your right. Match your shots to the drones and line up special targets. Play Wave Mode for successive enemy waves or race the clock in Time Trial. Choose lives, flicker settings and enemy types, and replay the shooting tutorial.

HYPER ARROW
Guide your flight through ring courses in Forest, Neon City and Cave. Each world offers 15 tracks in each of three modes:
- Score: pass rings and reach the finish.
- Race: compete against three AI rivals.
- Arcade: keep flying through looping courses as the speed increases.

That is 135 world, mode and track combinations. The Arrow tutorial introduces steering, rings, boost and recovery. View your results and stats, and adjust audio and flight comfort options in Settings.
